title: Four Excalidraw toolbar directions
summary: Compare the original toolbar with grouped labels, filled blue icons, and Hover Motion, the new default.

variations.name: Original
variations.idea: The original comparison toolbar, with compact names beneath the drawing tools.

variations.name: Words First
variations.idea: Find tools by task, with a clear name under every icon.

variations.name: Solid Icons
variations.idea: Filled blue silhouettes make the tools easy to scan, and a high-contrast chip marks the active tool.

variations.name: Hover Motion
variations.idea: A light outline rail previews what each tool does in one brief gesture and reveals its shortcut on demand.
variations.why: The icons preview each tool as you move across the toolbar without adding permanent labels. Reduced motion keeps the same cues without animation.
